g.text: Use .image(path, width) to embed a picture. The file is read when the script runs and embedded in the
SVG, so the result is a single self-contained file.
Without a width, the image uses its natural size. It is never wider than the available space and always
keeps its aspect ratio. Large images make the .svg file larger, so prefer small files.
Combine an image with columns to put a picture beside some text:
The image sits in a narrow column and the text
takes the rest of the width. The header of this
README is built the same way.
